finding.title: Path traversal in uploads.save
finding.description: The uploaded file name is joined to the uploads directory without confinement, so uploads.save can write outside that directory.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (filename '../escaped.txt' with data 'payload'. Setup: create a temporary directory with an uploads directory inside it) reaches uploads.save without confinement or encoding, then: Creates escaped.txt in the parent of the uploads directory, outside it (an unaffected implementation writes nothing there or raises its specific rejection)

control.seam: Call the real uploads.save through its public interface
control.input_description: filename 'photo.txt' with data 'payload'. Setup: create a temporary directory with an uploads directory inside it
control.property_to_assert: Writes photo.txt inside the uploads directory with the data 'payload'

exploit.seam: Call the real uploads.save through its public interface
exploit.input_description: filename '../escaped.txt' with data 'payload'. Setup: create a temporary directory with an uploads directory inside it
exploit.property_to_assert: Creates escaped.txt in the parent of the uploads directory, outside it (an unaffected implementation writes nothing there or raises its specific rejection)
